decision: Lock 2017 population-weighted PM2.5 and four log-rate regression variants
basis: Article Methods sections 2.1-2.2 and Table 1; locked AERIS contract.

decision: Use World Bank EN.ATM.PM25.MC.M3 for exposure
basis: It is the article-named public indicator for national population-weighted PM2.5 and supplied all 36 2017 records.

decision: Use JHU daily global series for COVID outcomes
basis: The current WHO direct archive was retrievable but weekly, making exact day-60/day-80 extraction impossible without interpolation. JHU supplied daily national cumulative series.
US physician indicator values were null for all article-permitted fallback years (2015-2017); no imputation or year expansion was used.

decision: Define day 60/day 80 with first confirmed case as day 1
basis: Article specifies days since first confirmed positive case. Both case and death series are anchored to the case date in executable code.
